questionText: Consider a processor operating at 4 MHz. A DMA controller transfers 8 bytes in 1 cycle from a device to main memory through cycle stealing at regular intervals. Which one of the following is the data transfer rate (in bits per second) of the DMA controller if 1% of the processor cycles are used for DMA?
explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters
Processor frequency = $4\text{ MHz} = 4 \times 10^6\text{ cycles/second}$
Data transferred per DMA cycle = $8\text{ bytes} = 8 \times 8 = 64\text{ bits}$
Percentage of processor cycles used for DMA = $1\%$

Step 2: Calculate DMA cycles per second
$\text{DMA cycles per second} = 1\% \times (4 \times 10^6) = 0.01 \times 4,000,000 = 40,000\text{ cycles/second}$

Step 3: Calculate data transfer rate
$\text{Data Transfer Rate} = \text{DMA cycles per second} \times \text{bits per cycle}$
$\text{Data Transfer Rate} = 40,000 \times 64 = 2,560,000\text{ bits per second} = 25,60,000\text{ bits per second}$

Therefore, the correct option is C.
